{{Quote|Oh, and be careful with those storage tanks — the illerium becomes highly volatile if it's exposed to air.|[[Naren Bluuis]]|<ref name="Counterstrike">{{JournalCite|8|Counterstrike (Adventure Journal)}}</ref>}}
'''Illerium''' was a valuable chemical that was often [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] to needed worlds.

==Characteristics==
Illerium was highly volatile, especially when exposed to air. This property made it a necessary part of the manufacturing of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejection seats]] and [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], as it supplied the necessary force to propel the vehicle away from its ship. It could also be used in much the same way as [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]], but with much smaller results.<ref name="Counterstrike" />

During the [[Galactic War]], a [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] variant called [[isotope-5]] was found on [[Makeb]].<ref name="Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>
